import subprocess, re

# Read the full file
result = subprocess.run(['cat', 'markdown/extensions/toc.py'], capture_output=True, text=True)
content = result.stdout
lines = content.split('\n')

# Find where to insert new functions (after striptags, before nest_toc_tokens)
insert_idx = None
for i, line in enumerate(lines):
    if line.strip() == "return re.sub(r'<[^>]+>', '', text)":
        insert_idx = i + 1
        # Skip blank lines after this
        while insert_idx < len(lines) and lines[insert_idx].strip() == '':
            insert_idx += 1
        break

print(f"Insert index: {insert_idx}")
print(f"Line at insert_idx: {lines[insert_idx]}")

# New functions to add
new_functions = '''

def run_postprocessors(md: Markdown, text: str) -> str:
    """Apply every registered postprocessor in md.postprocessors to text and return the result."""
    for pp in md.postprocessors:
        text = pp.run(text)
    return text


def render_inner_html(md: Markdown, elem: etree.Element) -> str:
    """Return the serialized inner HTML of an ElementTree element (not including the tag itself)."""
    parts = []
    if elem.text:
        parts.append(elem.text)
    for child in elem:
        parts.append(md.serializer(child))
        if child.tail:
            parts.append(child.tail)
    return ''.join(parts)

'''

# Insert the new functions
lines.insert(insert_idx, new_functions)

# Now find and replace the run method
# Find start of run method
run_start = None
run_end = None
for i, line in enumerate(lines):
    if '    def run(self, doc: etree.Element) -> None:' in line:
        run_start = i
    if run_start is not None and i > run_start:
        stripped = line.strip()
        if stripped and not line.startswith('        ') and not line.startswith('    def run'):
            run_end = i
            break

print(f"Run method: lines {run_start+1} to {run_end}")

# New run method
new_run = '''    def run(self, doc: etree.Element) -> None:
        # Get a list of id attributes
        used_ids = set()
        for el in doc.iter():
            if "id" in el.attrib:
                used_ids.add(el.attrib["id"])

        toc_tokens = []
        for el in doc.iter():
            if isinstance(el.tag, str) and self.header_rgx.match(el.tag):
                self.set_level(el)

                # Process heading content through run_postprocessors + striptags
                inner_html = render_inner_html(self.md, el)
                # Remove footnote reference superscripts from inner HTML
                inner_html = re.sub(r'<sup[^>]*>.*?footnote-ref.*?</sup>', '', inner_html)
                processed_text = run_postprocessors(self.md, inner_html)
                name = striptags(processed_text)

                # Do not override pre-existing ids
                if "id" not in el.attrib:
                    # Apply html.unescape only before slugify so slugify operates on decoded Unicode
                    innertext = html.unescape(inner_html)
                    el.attrib["id"] = unique(self.slugify(innertext, self.sep), used_ids)

                if int(el.tag[-1]) >= self.toc_top and int(el.tag[-1]) <= self.toc_bottom:
                    data_toc_label = el.attrib.get('data-toc-label')
                    if data_toc_label is not None:
                        label_name = striptags(data_toc_label)
                        del el.attrib['data-toc-label']
                    else:
                        label_name = name

                    toc_tokens.append({
                        'level': int(el.tag[-1]),
                        'id': el.attrib["id"],
                        'name': label_name,
                        'html': processed_text,
                        'data-toc-label': data_toc_label if data_toc_label is not None else '',
                    })

                if self.use_anchors:
                    self.add_anchor(el, el.attrib["id"])
                if self.use_permalinks not in [False, None]:
                    self.add_permalink(el, el.attrib["id"])

        toc_tokens = nest_toc_tokens(toc_tokens)
        div = self.build_toc_div(toc_tokens)
        if self.marker:
            self.replace_marker(doc, div)

        # serialize and attach to markdown instance.
        toc = self.md.serializer(div)
        for pp in self.md.postprocessors:
            toc = pp.run(toc)
        self.md.toc_tokens = toc_tokens
        self.md.toc = toc

'''

# Replace the run method
new_lines = lines[:run_start] + [new_run] + lines[run_end:]

# Write back
new_content = '\n'.join(new_lines)
with open('markdown/extensions/toc.py', 'w') as f:
    f.write(new_content)

print("File written successfully")
